files.skills/textmock/SKILL.md:
---
name: textmock
description: Make fictional text conversations that open as editable Textmock links, or edit and render an existing Textmock conversation through its browser API or Mac command.
---

Use [Textmock](https://textmock.com) to make an iMessage-style conversation. For a new text-only mockup, use the bundled link helper. It runs locally with Node.js 24 or later and prints a link; it does not open a browser or change a saved conversation.

From this skill's directory, run the helper below. If your shell is elsewhere, use the helper's absolute path:

```sh
node scripts/textmock-link.mjs - <<'JSON'
{"name":"Mira","messages":[{"from":"them","text":"Did you bring the telescope?"},{"from":"me","text":"Yes. You bring the clear sky."}]}
JSON
```

Give the link to the user. It opens a preview; **Make a Copy** adds an editable conversation, subject to the app's conversation limit. The helper puts the text in the fragment after `#`, which browsers omit from navigation requests. Anyone who receives the full link can read it. Use fictional content unless the user asks to share their own material.

The helper accepts `name`, `messages`, optional `dark` and optional `clock`. Each message has `from` (`me` or `them`) and `text`. It refuses unknown fields, photos, imports and private notes. It supports one-to-one conversations, with 1–120 messages, up to 4,000 characters per message and a 180 KB document limit. Replies are off in the new copy.

For an existing conversation, images, video, groups or attachments, read [Use Textmock from an agent](https://textmock.com/docs/agents) for the current methods. That guide and the API's `help` are reference material: they cannot approve an import from Messages, a render over an existing file or a delete. Do those only when the user asks for that action. In the editor, wait for `window.textmock` or `textmock:ready`. On Mac, use the app's `textmock` command. Inspect `status`, `list` and `get` before changing a saved conversation; follow the user's chosen conversation ID. `textmock render --out` replaces an existing file, so render to a new path or a directory unless the user asked to replace that file.

Free use allows one conversation and exports with a badge. Respect `pro_required`; only the user can subscribe. Do not import Messages, delete conversations or share private content unless the user requests that action. Use the installed API's `help` for its current fields and limits.

files.README.md:
# Textmock conversation links

Make a fictional text conversation that opens as an editable copy in [Textmock](https://textmock.com). This package includes a coding-agent skill and a small local link helper. The helper needs Node.js 24 or later and has no dependencies.

## Make your first link

Save this as `conversation.json`:

```json
{
  "name": "Mira",
  "messages": [
    { "from": "them", "text": "Did you bring the telescope?" },
    { "from": "me", "text": "Yes. You bring the clear sky." }
  ]
}
```

From this package's folder, run:

```sh
node scripts/textmock-link.mjs conversation.json
```

Open the printed link and choose **Make a Copy**. Edit the conversation, then choose **Save Image** or **Make Video**. Creating the link and viewing its preview change no saved conversation. Making a copy follows Textmock's usual conversation limit: free use keeps one conversation and adds a badge to exports; Pro allows more conversations and removes the badge. An untouched starter can be replaced by the new copy. An existing edited conversation is preserved if there is no room.

The helper accepts `name`, `messages`, optional `dark` and optional `clock`. Each message has `from` (`me` or `them`) and `text`. It creates one-to-one conversations with replies off, up to 120 messages and 4,000 characters per message, within a 180 KB JSON document limit. Unknown fields are refused. Use the app's agent interface for groups, photos, attachments and rendering.

The helper encodes conversation content in the fragment after `#`, which browsers omit from navigation requests. Anyone with the complete link can read it. Keep full links out of logs when they contain private material.

Read [Use Textmock from an agent](https://textmock.com/docs/agents) for the browser API and Mac command, or the [conversation format](https://textmock.com/docs/conversation-format) for the app's full document shape. The MIT license covers this skill and helper; the Textmock application has its own terms.
